It looks like I don't have write permissions for that file yet. Please approve the edit and I'll apply the changes. Here's a summary of what changed and why:

**Changes from the existing implementation:**

| | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| `fallback` prop | Static `ReactNode` — hides the retry button | `renderFallback(error, reset)` render prop — caller gets both the error and the reset function |
| `componentDidCatch` logging | `console.error(error, info.componentStack)` | Structured object with `message`, `name`, `stack`, `componentStack` — easier to filter in DevTools/Sentry |
| `componentStack` capture | Done in `componentDidCatch` | Same, but now displayed in a collapsible `<details>` in the default UI |
| Default fallback UI | Bare `<pre>` + unstyled button | Accessible `role="alert"` container with a styled retry button and collapsible stack trace |

**Usage:**

```tsx
// Default fallback
<ErrorBoundary>
  <MyWidget />
</ErrorBoundary>

// Custom fallback with access to the error and retry
<ErrorBoundary renderFallback={(err, reset) => (
  <MyCustomError message={err.message} onRetry={reset} />
)}>
  <MyWidget />
</ErrorBoundary>
```

Once you grant file write permission I'll apply the edit.
